Because when I joined Chick Webb, we went out on the road. We stayed out there for six months, we came back, you know. In and out,, you know. We went back to the Savoy Ballroom.
And '37 was the beginning of Chick making his move, because we had got some money from these one nighters, and college dates and things like that.
And he came back to the Savoy and he had a little -- and the band was beginning to -- After I had got back, we had moved the band a little bit -- a step little bit more.
Because when I came in, Chick Webb wanted me to -- just you like you say, straw boss -- take over everything, you know.
Take some of the worries off of his shoulder, you know. This began to move the band up, because then we got more things done.
We began to get -- pick music for Ella Fitzgerald, and we was going into a different type of arrangement type of thing.
